title: MCP Compliance Report
description: Structured output of the mcp-compliance test suite. Stable, versioned contract — increment schemaVersion on breaking changes. Consumed by Yaw MCP and third-party dashboards.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this report schema. Breaking changes bump the major version.

specVersion.description: MCP spec version tested against, e.g. "2025-11-25".

toolVersion.description: Version of the mcp-compliance tool that produced this report.

url.description: HTTP URL or stdio display string for the server under test.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the report was generated.

score.description: Weighted compliance score: required tests 70%, optional 30%.

grade.description: Letter grade derived from score. A>=90, B>=75, C>=60, D>=40, F<40.

overall.description: High-level verdict: pass = all required tests passed, partial = some failed, fail = many failed.

skipped.description: How many of `passed` measured nothing (TestResult.skipped). Optional: reports written before this field existed omit it. Skips are counted in `passed` and in the score denominator.

categories.description: Per-category pass/total counts, keyed by TestCategory.

skipped.description: How many of this category's `passed` measured nothing. Optional; older reports omit it.

warnings.description: Non-fatal diagnostics from the test run. Exact duplicates are dropped and the list is capped at 50 entries: past that, the first 50 are kept and one final entry, "... and N more warning(s) suppressed", says how many were dropped.

skipped.description: True when the check measured nothing: a precondition was absent (no --auth, no tools declared, a check that does not apply on this transport) or an earlier check could not attribute the server's refusal. A skip is still `passed: true` -- it is not a failure, and it counts in summary.passed and the score -- so this flag is the only thing that distinguishes it. Optional: absent means the check produced a verdict, and a result with `passed: false` never carries it.

specRef.description: Deep link to the relevant spec section.
